title: Head of Brahma
provenance: Old Talab near Bhagavati shrine of villages virnora, pernem tq. Goa.
brief_description: One Chaturmukha Brahma wearing jathamukuta. The faces are damaged.
detailed_description: The image depicts Goddess Mahisasur-Mardini wearing Makuta Holding a variety of objects, including a clockwise conch shell, dagger, sword, and spearhead. Her left leg is placed on the back of a demon Buffalo. The pedestal and prabhavali are decorated with flower motifs.
